icd_linked.llm_icd_reason: Mapped ICD at rank 1 is E13.10 (other specified diabetes mellitus with ketoacidosis without coma), while the billed primary code is O24.03 (pre-existing type 1 diabetes mellitus, in the puerperium), an obstetric chapter code that takes coding sequencing priority in a puerperal admission. E13.10 is neither the same code nor an acceptable substitute for the obstetric pre-existing type 1 diabetes code (which would pair with E10.10, not E13.10).
